notes: v2.24.0 — Posting Coverage ke nishan (aap ki darkhwast par): Page Ownership aur Connection Monitoring mein har Page par saaf nishan — ✍️ Posting mumkin (kis connected profile ke zariye) ya 🔑 Connect zaroori (kin profiles mein se ek ko connect karna hoga). Connection Monitoring mein ye bhi nazar ayega ke kis profile ko connect karne se sab se zyada Pages par posting khul jayegi — taake aap sirf zaroori profiles ko hi connect karein. Nishan app ke paas mojood asal token ki jaanch par banta hai, andazay par nahi.
